# WML-306 policy fixtures

These fixtures are derived from the policy requirements in WAP-191-WML 1.3 sections 11.3.1,
12.1 through 12.4, and 12.5.5. They intentionally combine the specification rules rather than
copying a published example: access is evaluated before transition, low-memory recovery is
bounded and predictable, unknown alternate-DTD markup is ignored around recognized content,
and failed tasks must not commit partial state.
